features.featureTitle: Update the `linux_bundle_run.sh` and `package_linux_bundle.sh` scripts to include all necessary deployment artifacts (built frontend `dist/`, backend canister WASM, `dfx.json`, Apache vhost config example, and the `rpi_event_runner.sh` script) in a single timestamped `.tar.gz` bundle that a user can extract and run on a fresh Linux machine with `dfx` and Apache installed.

Create or update a Linux installation guide (`frontend/docs/linux-local-test-bundle.md`) that covers: prerequisites (Node.js, dfx, Apache), building the bundle, deploying the local ICP replica, configuring Apache to serve the `dist/` folder, starting the GPIO server on port 3000, and verifying the full stack is operational.
